title: Test selection and repository workflow contracts

requirements.initial: The repository has root and package-local test commands.
requirements.action: Select an owner/risk boundary and inspect collection-wide triggers.
requirements.expected: Stable command scopes and hermetic default collection remain authoritative.

evidence.assertion: keeps one composable namespace around the hermetic full suite
evidence.scope: Manifest/config contract; does not execute all selected tests.

evidence.assertion: reruns every project when collection-wide inputs change
evidence.scope: Config input contract, not a remote CI run.

evidence.assertion: assigns every repository spec to exactly one owner and one risk lane

requirements.gap: Invocation/config assertions alone do not prove actual remote CI or required branch protection.

requirements.initial: A candidate uses the intended branch/channel.
requirements.action: Evaluate workflow contracts and final artifact acceptance.
requirements.expected: Source and publication authority retain their existing boundaries.

evidence.scope: Static workflow checks; build/publication workflows are not executed by group discovery.

requirements.gap: Stage 2 connects missing deterministic journey gates after measuring their runtime; release policy remains unchanged.
